LESSON: WRITING 9.3.1 FUNCTIONAL WRITING – LETTERS OF APPLICATION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.3: Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do we make applications whenever we need formal opportunities?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognise the components of a letter of application for information
2. write a letter of application for a scholarship for effective communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 9.3.1 FUNCTIONAL WRITING – LETTERS OF APPLICATION
This lesson teaches Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application for Grade 9 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

STUDY STEPS
1. recognise the components of a letter of application for information
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. write a letter of application for a scholarship for effective communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application above.
2. Explain Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we make applications whenever we need formal opportunities?
2. How do application letters differ from other letters?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. recognise the components of a letter of application for information
2. write a letter of application for a scholarship for effective communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
